walkthroughs.body_html: 1. Receptor detects stimulus. 2. Sensory neuron sends signal to spinal cord. 3. Relay neuron processes it. 4. Motor neuron fires. 5. Effector (muscle) reacts. The brain feels pain only after the response.

Strength: evolutionary survival value; well supported physiologically. Weakness: Taylor argued females show tend-and-befriend, suggesting the response is gender-biased. Chronic activation also harms long-term health (high cortisol).

'Jay's heart pounds before an exam.' Identify the sympathetic NS at work and adrenaline release. Suggest parasympathetic calming via breathing exercises. Link to homeostasis: body returns to balance after the threat passes.
